title: Support VAT return reporting frequencies in Denmark
summary: Danish electronic VAT declaration now reads SKAT VAT return periods with their reporting frequency and calculates monthly, quarterly and semi-annual periods. A feature-flagged legacy quarterly fallback remains, and overlapping periods and invalid due dates are rejected.
key_points: New reporting frequency enum, and period parsing that handles monthly, quarterly and semi-annual periods
Prevents overlapping VAT return periods and rejects invalid SKAT due dates
Legacy quarterly calculation kept as a feature-flagged fallback; new key vault secret DKElecVAT-ReportingFrequencyEnabled
Legacy Q2 boundaries corrected; nested response periods processed regardless of frequency order
Invalid flag configuration logged as warning telemetry; tests added
quote: support monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual period calculations
